newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hitachi Seiki seen posting Y600 mln H1 loss--paper.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi Seiki seen posting Y600 mln H1 loss--paper.

text.p: Hitachi Seiki Co Ltd is expected to have posted a parent current loss of 600 million yen in the six months ended September 30, a Japanese newspaper reported on Thursday.

The business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the company, a major manufacturer of machine tools, may also post a parent current loss of 600 million yen for the full year in the face of dwindling sales of its products. In May, the company predicted a parent current profit of 300 million yen for the full year. Company officials were not immediately available for comment on the newspaper report.
